parts.title: PART 1: READING INPUT  A research question is the engine of your Passion Project. It drives everything: what you read, what you take notes on, and what you write. A GREAT research question is open, complex, and meaningful.
content: 📖 A research question is the engine of your Passion Project. It drives everything: what you read, what you take notes on, and what you write. A GREAT research question is open, complex, and meaningful.

There are different levels of research questions. Level 1 questions ask for facts: 'What is climate change?' These are easy to answer but don't help you think deeply. Level 2 questions ask for explanation: 'How does climate change affect weather patterns?' These require reading and analysis. Level 3 questions ask for evaluation and opinion: 'What should governments do about climate change?' These require judgment and arguments.

For your Passion Project, your main question should be Level 2 or Level 3. Your sub-questions can include Level 1 questions to build up your knowledge. By the end of your research, you should be able to answer ALL your questions — and that is your report!
